scope.research_boundary: Audit only the already-linked candidate files, source records, research-attempt files, B149 scope/results, and registered campaign histories. These are the 11 B149 fields still in the fresh ready queue. Determine whether existing exact evidence supports any retained candidate value. No new web/public-post query, page open, URL retry, source creation, or external contact is in scope. Root is the sole writer. Promote a field only where an already-linked exact source supports it; otherwise convert its latest open B149 attempt to blocked with a concise exact-model reason and accepted references to existing evidence, preserving all earlier attempts and campaigns.
field_rules: Complete-bike weight must match the retained exact build and preserve size, included equipment, approximation, and weighing basis; frame weight cannot substitute.
Tire clearance requires an exact-model maximum; fitted tire size alone does not establish the maximum.
Keep generations, variants, and regional builds distinct. Do not convert an indirect conflict or fitted width into a specification.
excluded: No image, price, drivetrain, warranty, purchase-route, UI, or unrelated catalog changes.
No external delivery, GitHub mutation, commit, push, PR, merge, publish, or production write.
